verdict.rationale: Medusa ships an official JS SDK (verified via runtime probe), documented CLI, a customization Framework with modules, Admin Injection Zones, and extensive scaffolding/starter guides (storefront dev guides, B2B recipe, commerce modules docs), which covers SDKs and scaffolding tooling well. However, there is no evidence of a formal 'review/distribution path' (e.g., a curated plugin/app marketplace with submission and review process) — customizations are self-hosted rather than distributed through a vetted store. Missing for 10: documented app-store/marketplace submission and review workflow, independent hands-on confirmation of the extension-building process end-to-end.
